_about: Vehicle, motor, recovery, environment and sensor assumptions for the IGT mock flight (tools/flight_profile/generate.py). Every number carries its source in the matching _source key. 'Rylan' = stated by the team; 'repo' = read from GroundStation26/FlightComputer26; 'assumed' = engineering estimate from public data where the repos have no spec. Swap in measured values as they become available; nothing else needs to change.

vehicle.dry_mass_source: assumed: sum of mass_breakdown_kg (no as-built mass in the repos). generate.py --tune-dry-mass solves the dry mass that would reach a target apogee with the configured motor.
vehicle.mass_breakdown_source: assumed: typical student 6 in N2O hybrids (e.g. published IREC/SA Cup technical reports put 6 in hybrids at 25-40 kg dry); run tank: the 7.0 kg first guessed for an assumed 12 L tank, split as about 2.0 kg of bulkheads and closures (kept) plus 5.0 kg of Al 6061 wall scaled by length (same diameter) to the measured 15.85 L (5.0 x 15.8537/12 = 6.6 kg), so 8.6 kg; still an estimate, not a weighed part
vehicle.run_tank_volume_source: measured: from Rylan 2026-11-23, 967.45 in^3 (x 0.016387064 L/in^3 = 15.8537 L); replaces the assumed 12 L. The apogee planner default and the firmware sim plant take it from here
vehicle.fins_source: assumed: trapezoidal fins sized for about 2 cal static margin on a 30:1 body
vehicle.stability_source: assumed: Barrowman CNa about 2 (nose) + about 10 (4 fins, this planform); 1.5-2.5 cal is the usual IREC/SA Cup requirement (DTEG: at least 1.5 cal off the rail)
vehicle.pitch_inertia_source: assumed: I = factor * m L^2 / 12 (uniform rod); mass is concentrated toward the middle (tank, chamber)
vehicle.roll_source: assumed: about 0.2 deg of fin cant/misalignment gives about 1 rev/s near Mach 0.8, typical of amateur flight logs; roll time constant = 30 m / airspeed
vehicle.fc_station_source: assumed: AV bay between the drogue and main bays

motor.source: repo-measured: thrust curve from the 2026-11-16 static fire, thrust = g*(KG1000 + KG50 unloading - burned) (extract_thrust.py; the rocket hangs from the 50 kg fill cell and presses the 1000 kg cell only once lifted), 9.19 kN s (7.6-10.1; the KG1000 alone gave 7.1), burn 5.65 s, peak about 3.3 kN; see motors/testfire_20261116.json. Propellant 6.7 kg = 5.6 kg N2O (KG50 fill cell before valve open) + about 1.1 kg fuel (assumed O/F 5), so delivered Isp about 140 s. total_impulse_ns null = the measured curve as is; a number rescales the curve to that impulse, by k^e on the thrust axis and k^(1-e) on the time axis (e = impulse_scaling_thrust_exponent; 0.5 = a bigger tank and injector), keeping the measured shape, and, with scale_propellant_with_impulse, the propellant mass at the measured delivered Isp. Nozzle exit diameter not in the repos (assumed 70 mm; only affects base drag while thrusting). Residual vapour 4% assumed. A +-3% 14 Hz feed-coupled oscillation is assumed (the smoothed curve removes it).

aero.source: OpenRocket technical documentation ch. 3.4 component build-up (friction with roughness limit and compressibility, base drag 0.12+0.13M^2 removed over the nozzle exit while thrusting, fin LE/TE pressure drag); +10% friction and 0.02 for rail buttons, fill/vent ports, joints. Transonic wave-drag rise of 0.3 from M 0.8 to 1.05 approximates a 5:1 ogive (no measured data). Gives Cd about 0.45-0.55 subsonic for a 30:1 body.

launch.ignition_source: repo: docs/integrated-ground-test.md 4.2: VB pilot at Launch + 10 s; replayed liftoff about t_ms 10000
launch.rail_source: 17 ft rail (SA Cup/IREC tower); effective travel taken as the full length
launch.tilt_source: IREC/SA Cup launch angle about 5 deg (DTEG allows up to 10); azimuth = tools/igt_csv.py default

attitude.source: assumed: aerodynamic pitch damping ratio 0.05-0.1 for finned rockets; hanging airframe lightly damped

recovery.drogue_source: assumed: FC detect_descent needs vel <= -4.25 m/s for 4 samples after Apogee + 80 ms (fcconfig.h), so about 1-1.5 s after true apogee
recovery.rates_source: task: drogue about 25 m/s, main about 6 m/s; canopy CdA solved from these rates. Fill times, opening-shock overshoot (Ck 1.3-1.4) and swing from Knacke, Parachute Recovery Systems Design Manual (NWC TP 6575) typical values; ejection/snatch impulses assumed (CO2 separation, shock-cord snatch)

environment.site_source: repo: FC LAUNCH_SITE_*_DEFAULT (fcconfig.h, IREC 2026, Midland TX); override with --site to match the station's Launch site setting
environment.temp_source: USSA-76 standard day; set e.g. +15 for a June afternoon in west Texas
environment.wind_source: task: 3-5 m/s with gusts; 1/7 power-law profile from 10 m, capped at 1.4x (reached near 110 m: the power law only describes the surface layer); Gauss-Markov gusts
environment.pressure_drift_source: assumed: slow synoptic drift, enough to leave a sub-metre baro offset at landing

imu.part: Bosch BMI088 (accel 24 g @ 1600 Hz ODR, gyro 2000 dps @ 2000 Hz ODR; repo accelerometer.c/gyroscope.c)
imu.source: BMI088 datasheet (BST-BMI088-DS001): accel 175 ug/sqrt(Hz), zero-g offset +-20 mg typ, 16 bit (1365 LSB/g at 24 g); gyro 0.014 dps/sqrt(Hz), zero-rate offset +-1 dps, 16.384 LSB/dps at 2000 dps. Range clipped just inside the FC's MAX_ACC = 24 g validator. Burn vibration and buffet assumed (no flight data in the repos); point-sampled like the FC, which takes the latest sample each cycle.

baro.part: Bosch BMP390 (OSR x8 pressure, ODR 100 Hz, IIR coef 3; repo barometer.c)
baro.alt_formula: 44330 * (1 - (p/p0)^0.1903), the FC's own (barometer.h ALT_PRES_CONST, BARO_HYPSOMETRIC_EXPONENT), p0 = pad pressure
baro.source: BMP390 datasheet (BST-BMP390-DS002): relative accuracy +-3 Pa, absolute +-50 Pa, raw RMS noise a few Pa at x8 (we use 2 Pa before the IIR); IIR coef 3 as configured; static-port Cp and AV-bay lag assumed (port-location dependent); CO2 ejection pressure pulse in the AV bay assumed (well known in amateur rocketry, magnitude varies)

gps.rate_source: repo: FC replay delivers GPS at 10 Hz (ground_test.c IGT_GPS_PERIOD_MS)
gps.source: assumed u-blox class receiver: CEP about 2.5 m; loses lock under boost (>4 g dynamic-model limit) and reacquires a few seconds after burnout. Rows are omitted during the dropout (the FC replay bridges the gap; the ascent filter does not use GPS).

output.source: repo: docs/integrated-ground-test.md 4.2 recommends IMU 100 Hz, baro 50 Hz, GPS 10 Hz. The FC disables the IMU in descent (kalman.c descent_initialize), so IMU rows drop to imu_descent_hz from apogee + imu_full_rate_after_apogee_s, except +-window around the main deployment and the landing. The replay interpolates linearly between rows.
